text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Buena Vista! The first Classic-tier 
Tiara Umamusume to do it in years! She has 
claimed victory in the Arima Kinen—!!
(Waaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vistaaaa, congratulations!" "Great 
job everyone, too!!" "That was the best 
race ever!"

The pouring cheers were profoundly warm. 
While honoring the winner... they also 
showed appreciation for every single 
Umamusume who made this year so exciting.
choice_data_list: (So this is the air of the Grand Prix—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: *pant*... ugh...
choice_data_list: (Buena...?)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-chan, congratulations...!" "That 
was such an incredible run~!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vistaaa!!" "—You're the heroine of 
the next era!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much! I――
choice_data_list: Buena! Get back here!
Buena! Come back!

text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista looks utterly exhausted... 
Thinking that, I immediately called out to 
her, and she came staggering back toward 
me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... It looks like I pushed myself 
just a little too hard...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen... really is 
incredible...!
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Are you hurt?
Are you okay? Are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "I'm... totally fine! Hey, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I... I lived up to everyone's 
expectations... didn't I?
choice_data_list: Yeah. ...Congratulations, truly!
Yeah. ...Truly, congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...
choice_data_list: Now, Buena—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah... Journey, sa...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let me give you a hand. First, we should 
head to the waiting room, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank you very much. I'm all right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry you had to see me in such a 
pathetic state...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Given what a fierce run that 
was, it's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Once again, congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Today brings an end to this year... while 
also foretelling the next.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I am convinced—next year's 
star will be you as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, the racing world changes in the 
blink of an eye. Just like when you 
appeared—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—New storms are constantly brewing. Before 
you get swept up in them... I hope you 
reach a magnificent view.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Journey-san...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"You're encouraging me, aren't you? Thank 
you very much! However—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even if I get swallowed up by a storm, I 
won't care! Because I have—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because I have people who will pull me up.
choice_data_list: (Buena...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose that was unsolicited 
encouragement. Well, as long as I'm 
meddling, here's one more thing—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Please watch your step in the mud. 
...Well then, good work today."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The mud at our feet... Could they be 
referring to the race?"
choice_data_list:
I don't know. But... I should remember 
that.
I don't know. But... I'll remember that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. Knowing Journey-san, it's 
definitely meaningful advice.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Phew... So the Classic Year is coming to 
an end, huh.
choice_data_list:
We've got to set our goals for next year, 
too.

We need to decide on our goals for next 
year, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Assuming the ultimate goal is the 
Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep living up to their 
expectations all the way there. Because 
reaching that point with everyone's 
feelings behind me is what matters most."
choice_data_list:
In that case, the Victoria Mile would be 
first, I guess.

text_block_list.text:
Many Senior-class Umamusume from the Tiara 
route compete in the Victoria Mile. It's 
the race that crowns the strongest Tiara 
runner over the mile.
choice_data_list:
Because everyone wants to see you looking 
like the Queen you are.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I see. Gotta show everyone how cool we can 
be! ...I wonder if Desire-chan is running 
too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If it's with Desire-chan, everyone will 
have even higher hopes for us.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I hope we can clash again.

Yeah, it'd be great if you two could clash 
again.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
...Buena Vista-san, we are ready for your 
interview...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah! Please wait just a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Does my hair and everything... 
look okay?
choice_data_list: Maybe it's sticking up a bit?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I wonder if I can fix it right 
away...
choice_data_list: Well, it's cute, so I think it's fine.
Well, it's cute, so why not?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Oof.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Don't just go saying things like that 
so casually, okay?

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
...Buena Vista-san! ...What about next 
year?... ...A message for your fans, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your questions, everyone. 
I'll answer them one by one!
choice_data_list:
(Looks like she's going to be super 
popular again next year...)

text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista successfully ran the Arima 
Kinen. Thanks in part to the race's 
prestige, her name became even more widely 
recognized by the public.
――Even more than I had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you see the recent Arima 
Kinen!? There was this super cute girl...!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I saw it~! It was Buena Vista-chan, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
That went super viral on UmaTok, right? 
The one where you running with all your 
might was so touching it brought people to 
tears!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! That made me look up a bunch 
of past footage too, and... she's 
seriously so cute, right?

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Plus, she's super strong! I might just 
have become a fan~!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Let's go cheer for her next time! 
—I can't wait to see Buena-chan next 
year~!
